extName.message: Stealth Browser Assistant — Hide & Mute Tabs

extDescription.message: Hide, mute, or close private and sensitive tabs with customizable Keywords and one-click Emergency Action controls.

cmdToggleMute.message: Toggle mute for tabs matching keywords

noKeywords.message: No keywords yet. Add a domain or word to start matching tabs.

langHelp.message: Choose the interface language, or follow your browser.

optionsKeywordsHelp.message: Each keyword matches a tab if it appears anywhere in the tab's URL or title (case-insensitive). Use a domain (e.g. bank.com) or any word (e.g. paystub).

optionsShortcutsHelp.message: Keyboard shortcuts can be customized at

emergencyHelp.message: Choose what happens when you press the emergency shortcut.

mediaPauseHelp.message: Choose whether to also stop media playback in matching tabs when they get muted or hidden.

mediaPauseLabel.message: Pause the videos and audio in them

matchHitHelp.message: Make tabs matching your keywords stand out.

cleanupHistoryDesc.message: Removes matching entries from your browsing history. Address bar suggestions may be reduced, but bookmarks or other sources can still surface them.

cleanupCookiesDesc.message: Cookies and other site data such as Local Storage

cleanupCookiesWarn.message: May log you out of websites

cleanupDownloadsDesc.message: Download history; does not delete the actual files

premiumUnlockFeature.message: Get premium to unlock this feature

premiumIntro.message: Premium unlocks every feature in this extension.

premiumActivateRevoked.message: This License Key has been revoked.

premiumActivateRefunded.message: This License Key has been refunded.

premiumActivateError.message: Activation failed. Please check your connection and try again.

cleanupHelp.message: Only cleans data for domains matching your keywords.

popupCleanNoKeywords.message: Add keywords to scope what gets cleaned

autoCleanupHelp.message: Cleans automatically $minutes$ minutes after the last matching tab is closed.

popupCleanDisabled.message: No cleanup items selected. Choose some in Settings.
